findings.claim: The app crate now directly imports and uses `futures_util` without any shown direct dependency update for `frf-app`, which can break `cargo check --workspace`.
findings.evidence: The hunk adds `use futures_util::StreamExt as _;` and later calls `futures_util::stream::unfold`, but the diff contains no corresponding change to `crates/frf-app/Cargo.toml`; constraint R1 requires `cargo check --workspace` to be clean.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `futures-util` as a direct dependency of `crates/frf-app` or avoid the new direct dependency.

findings.claim: The new gateway integration test directly imports `tokio_postgres` without any shown direct dependency update for `frf-gateway`.
findings.evidence: The new support module contains `use tokio_postgres::{Client, NoTls};`, while the `crates/frf-gateway/Cargo.toml` hunk only adds `frf-projection-surreal`, `base64`, and `sha2`; constraint R1 covers workspace/all-target compilation.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `tokio-postgres` as a direct dev-dependency or dependency of `crates/frf-gateway`.

findings.claim: The proposal document says the change is proposal-only with unchecked implementation tasks even though the submitted tasks are checked and implementation/evidence files claim completion.
findings.evidence: `proposal.md` states `Status: proposal only; all implementation tasks are unchecked.`, while `openspec/changes/pri-c009-entity-projection/tasks.md` marks tasks 1-5 as `[x]` and `.kbd-orchestrator/.../implementation.md` says `Status: **COMPLETE**`; constraint T2 requires honest surface/no doc drift.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the proposal status text to reflect the completed implementation or remove the stale statement.
